description: The Bell Star Dlx Mips Gloss-Black is engineered for everyday agility, rapid ventilation, and effortless usability, pairing agile street ergonomics with certified multi-impact protection. Built around a Advanced Multi-Composite (Carbon-Aramid-Glass / AIM+) shell weighing a featherweight 1306g, its multi-density EPS matrix is aerodynamically sculpted to isolate cabin noise to ~87 dB while dissipating kinetic impact forces across DOT, ECE 22.06 benchmarks. Inside, 3D laser-cut cheek pads tailor naturally to an Intermediate Oval profile with dedicated eyewear relief channels, secured by a glove-friendly quick-release ratcheting buckle for confident all-day riding.

introduction: Positioned in Bell's Full Face lineup, the bell_star_dlx_mips_gloss-black brings American engineering to riders seeking balance between weight, cabin acoustics, and impact protection. Designed for an Intermediate Oval fitment, it connects daily usability with certified DOT, ECE 22.06 track safety.
story:
The Bell Star Dlx Mips Gloss-Black represents Bell's dedicated protective engineering, incorporating aerodynamic shell sculpting and multi-density EPS impact damping. Its Advanced Multi-Composite (Carbon-Aramid-Glass / AIM+) shell dampens high-speed wind resonance while multi-density EPS channels absorb kinetic energy across direct and oblique impact vectors.

On the road, intake ports channel air across the scalp, keeping cabin noise around ~87 dB at 100 km/h. For riders seeking an Advanced Multi-Composite (Carbon-Aramid-Glass / AIM+) Full Face helmet tailored to an Intermediate Oval head shape, the Bell Star Dlx Mips Gloss-Black delivers verified safety and long-distance rider comfort.
